nodes.name: CC Pretreatment
nodes.procedure: A piece of CC (2 cm×4 cm) was first calcinated under 300°C for 1 h and washed ultrasonically in hydrochloric acid water (20 wt%) for 30 min, followed by several washes with ethanol and distilled water.

nodes.name: Mo-SnO2-x Solvothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: A mixed solution was prepared by dissolving SnCl4·5H2O (0.036 g), thioacetamide (0.036 g) and (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O (0.0011 g) into 30 mL isopropanol. Afterwards, the solution and pretreated CC were co-transferred into a Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave and treated at 180°C for 24 h and subsequently cooled to room temperature. Afterwards, the prepared CC sample was calcined in a muffle furnace at 500°C under air atmosphere for 2 h.

nodes.description: NO3RR performance evaluation using LSV and chronoamperometry in 0.5 M Na2SO4 + 0.1 M NaNO3
nodes.source_text: The electrocatalytic NO3RR performance of Mo-SnO2-x is investigated using an H-shaped cell in 0.5MNa2SO4 + 0.1MNaNO3 electrolyte. NO3- and possible liquid products are quantitatively determined by the colorimetric methods... Fig. 4a displays that the LSV current density increases significantly with the presence of NO3-... The NO3RR performance of Mo-SnO2-x is further quantified by combining chronoamperometry and colorimetric methods... achieves a maximum of 95.5% with a corresponding NH3 yield rate of 5.3mgh^{-1}cm^{-2} at -0.7V... exhibits a high NO3- to-NH3 selectivity... the NO3- to-NH3 conversion rates are over 92%

nodes.description: NO3RR performance comparison at -0.7 V vs RHE
nodes.source_text: As a sharp contrast, pristine SnO2 exhibits a rather inferior NO3RR activity and delivers an FENH3 of 46% with an NH3 yield rate of 1.2mgh^{-1}cm^{-2} at -0.7V, 2.1 times and 4.4 times lower than those of Mo-SnO2-x
during the ten consecutive cycles, no significant fluctuations in FENH3 and NH3 yield rate occur, indicating a good cycling stability
The long-time chronopotentiometry measurements show that the current density and corresponding FENH3 maintain nearly constant values

Electrochemical active surface area (ECSA) measurements present that the performance of Mo-SnO2-x normalized by ECSA follows a similar trend... indicating that Mo-SnO2-x has a higher intrinsic NO3RR activity than SnO2
electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) measurements show that Mo-SnO2-x possesses a lower charge transfer resistance than SnO2

nodes.description: Isotope labeling validation of NO3RR origin
nodes.source_text: 1H NMR spectra show typical 14NH4+ triple peaks and 15NH4+ double peaks when using 14NO3- and 15NO3-, respectively, demonstrating that the resulting NH3 is definitely derived from the NO3RR process

nodes.characterization_summary: Mo3d spectra of Mo-SnO2-x show peaks at 233.1 and 236.2 eV confirming Mo6+ valence; Sn3d peaks negatively shifted vs SnO2 indicating decreased Sn valence; O1s shows large VO peak area evidencing enriched oxygen vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Mo3d spectra of Mo - SnO2-x (Fig. 2a) show two deconvoluted peaks at 233.1 and 236.2eV, representing Mo6+2p5/2 and Mo6+2p3/2... From the Sn3d spectra (Fig. 2b), it is seen that Mo - SnO2-x shows negatively shifted Sn3d5/2/Sn3d3/2 peaks compared to SnO2... The existence of enriched VO in Mo - SnO2-x can be evidenced by the large area of VO peak in the O2p spectra (Fig. 2c)

nodes.characterization_summary: Mo K-edge XANES of Mo-SnO2-x close to MoO3 reference confirming +6 valence; Sn K-edge shows lower white line intensity than SnO2 implying less unoccupied states from VO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 2d shows Mo K-edge X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectra of Mo - SnO2-x and reference samples. It is obvious that the near-edge absorption energy of Mo - SnO2-x is very close to that of MoO3 reference... In the Sn K-edge XANES spectra (Fig. 2g), the white line peak intensity of Mo - SnO2-x is apparently lower than that of SnO2.

nodes.characterization_summary: Mo K-edge EXAFS shows peaks at 1.33Å and 3.08Å corresponding to Mo-O and Mo-Sn; absence of Mo-Mo bond confirms atomic dispersion; Sn K-edge shows reduced Sn-O bond intensity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Mo K-edge extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS, Fig. 2e) spectra of Mo - SnO2-x show two main peaks located at 1.33Å and 3.08Å corresponding to Mo-O and Mo-Sn scattering paths... The Sn K-edge EXAFS spectra (Fig. 2h) show a reduced Sn-O bond intensity of Mo - SnO2-x compared to SnO2.

nodes.characterization_summary: Strong g signal evidences existence of enriched VO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the strong g signal in the electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR, Fig. S2) spectra.

nodes.characterization_summary: ECSA measurements show Mo-SnO2-x has higher intrinsic NO3RR activity than SnO2 when performance normalized by ECSA.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Electrochemically active surface area (ECSA, Fig. S16) measurements present that the performance of Mo-SnO2-x normalized by ECSA (Fig. S17) follows a similar trend... indicating that Mo-SnO2-x has a higher intrinsic NO3RR activity than SnO2.

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows Mo-SnO2-x possesses lower charge transfer resistance than SnO2, implying high conductivity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS, Fig. S18) measurements show that Mo-SnO2-x possesses a lower charge transfer resistance than SnO2.
